The application is built, verified, and ready for your review.

## The application is ready — **http://maker:4000**

It starts empty (your private collection), so you'll see the calm "To read" empty state. Paste a real link to watch genuine details, icon, and preview image get fetched; everything you save persists between visits.

### Verification report (plain language)

I built the real application fresh from the 22 behaviours we approved — not from the exploration prototype — and verified it against them:

- **Automated checks: 26 tests, all passing.** These cover the query language (words, phrases, `#tags`, `and`/`or`/`not`, grouping, case-insensitivity, quoted operators), import/export round-trips (titles, tags, original dates, notes preserved; duplicates skipped), genuine metadata extraction and the graceful failure fallback, PDF detection, duplicate-address editing, reading-status vs archive independence (including that archive remembers each item's status), bulk actions, delete, preferences persistence, and saved searches.
- **Browser check of the real app:** saving, per-view search, tag filtering, formatted Markdown notes, text-size scaling, bulk mark-read, and import all work with no errors.
- **Genuine capabilities confirmed:** real page metadata is fetched server-side (verified against a live site), the favicon/preview image are collected and shown with letter/"no image" fallbacks, data is stored durably and privately on the server, and preserved copies are captured (the page as a local copy, PDFs as the file) with the optional Internet Archive link.

What each approved scenario maps to in code is recorded in `implementation/design/scenario-map.md`, with the design rationale in `decisions.md`.

### For acceptance

On the basis of the behaviour we approved together and this verification, **do you accept this software and agree to complete this cycle?**

If anything doesn't behave as we agreed, tell me and I'll classify it: a genuine mismatch with an approved behaviour I fix now within this cycle; anything that would *change or add* to what we approved I'll record for a later cycle (this first trial runs through acceptance of this cycle).
